description.value: Yummy Slice Pizza is a Canadian-owned fast-food pizza chain specializing in pizza by the slice, with a broad menu of classic and signature pies spanning meat, vegetarian, and South Asian-inspired options. The Williams Road location is one of several Richmond outlets within a wider Lower Mainland chain that also franchises across BC. Cyclists can order online for pickup or delivery, making it a convenient and quick refuelling stop.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: rack at 12m; rack at 50m; rack at 75m; rack at 88m.
